products.overview: Distillation gets your solvent dry, eventually, with heat, glassware, and someone watching the whole process. Labstation i SPS gets you there faster and safer. Pressurized nitrogen or argon pushes your solvent through two serial filter columns that strip out oxygen and moisture together, bringing moisture levels below 10 ppm depending on your starting solvent. Collect it straight into evacuated vessels, or feed it directly into a Labstation I glovebox for immediate use in an inert atmosphere. When a column runs out, swap it for a pre-activated replacement yourself, no regeneration cycle to wait on. Configure a modular unit for up to five solvents at once, or go compact with a single-solvent benchtop system that still delivers 800 liters before its column needs changing.

body: We built Labstation i SPS around a simple substitution: pressurized inert gas and two filter columns doing what a still used to do, without the heat, the glassware, or the standing watch. Nitrogen or argon at 99.999% purity pushes your solvent through, and both columns work in series so nothing slips through a single pass.

Purity holds below 10 ppm moisture depending on your starting solvent, and every column ships pre-activated. When one runs out after roughly 800 liters, you swap it yourself with a fresh one, no in-house regeneration step.

The modular multi-solvent unit handles up to five solvents from a confirmed list of eight compatible types, so you configure your five around what your lab actually runs. If your needs are simpler, the single-solvent benchtop unit delivers the same 800-liter capacity in a fraction of the footprint, with its own circulation pump for repeated purification cycles.
Modular unit: up to 5 solvents, steel frame, stainless steel (US304) piping and platform.
Single-solvent unit: 260 x 500 x 900 mm, benchtop, circulation pump included.
Working gas: nitrogen or argon, 99.999% purity or better.
Purifier columns: two per solvent, serial, pre-activated, user-replaceable.

sections.title: How Solvent Purification Works
body: Getting a solvent below 10 ppm moisture comes down to two things: consistent gas pressure and enough filtration to catch what a single pass would miss.

Nitrogen or argon at 99.999% purity pressurizes your solvent reservoir, driving the solvent through two filter columns in series. That serial arrangement is what pulls both oxygen and moisture out reliably, rather than relying on a single column to catch everything at once. From there, purified solvent goes straight into an evacuated vessel or directly into a connected glovebox, ready to use without an extra transfer step exposing it to air.
